name: CHRONOS-R
description: CHRONOS-R provides a Gaussian host benchmark for comparing model-update policies and a separate bounded Bernoulli reference for assessing frozen candidate changes. The reference includes independent future witnesses, an error-spending ledger, and a known-null change monitor. The Gaussian quickstart is illustrative and does not establish the statistical guarantees of the bounded reference. The archive contains package source, tests, examples, and their stated assumptions. The full neural experiments reported in the associated manuscript require a separate research package and are outside this benchmark record.
